pages.text: $(bold)Necklace:$() grants Fire Resistance.$(br2)$(bold)Bangle / Ring:$() ignites the target, or kindles a fire on the block you aim at.$(br2)$(bold)Cooldown:$() 2.0s per cast.$(br2)$(bold)Held by:$() Ruby*, Topaz*, Engravable Redstone, Engravable Quartz, Engravable Copper. $(o)(* creative only)$()
